name: Creator Monetization Pipeline Pack
description: Creates a repeatable X and YouTube research, content, experiment and performance system while keeping public posting owner-reviewed.

payload.content:
# Creator Monetization Pipeline

## Objective
Continuously convert current information and Matt's real interests into source-backed content experiments, then measure what actually earns attention or revenue.

## Candidate domains
Vehicles and repairs, dealership/reconditioning lessons that do not expose employer/customer confidential information, local practical projects, AI/local-agent building, appliance-repair business-building, crypto research/education and household/garage organization.

## Workflow
1. Research timely topics and audience questions.
2. Record source links and separate fact from opinion.
3. Draft several hooks/titles before spending effort on a full piece.
4. Create the post/thread/script/shot list as a reviewable draft.
5. Matt reviews before any public posting or owner-representing communication.
6. Record performance and compare with baseline.
7. Repeat winners only after evidence; retire weak formats instead of rationalizing them.

Never use confidential dealership/customer information, impersonate Matt publicly without approval, fabricate expertise, plagiarize content, or promise income.
